source: Original synthetic fixtures for an identity-pinned library reveal

cards.name: Fixture Forest Lens
cards.oracle_text: {1}{G}: Reveal the top card of your library. If it’s a creature card, put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, put it into your graveyard.

cards.name: Fixture Sunset Signal
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of your end step, reveal the top card of your library. If it’s a permanent card, you may put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, you may put it on the bottom of your library.

cards.name: Fixture Dawn Watch
cards.oracle_text: At the beginning of your upkeep, reveal the top card of your library. If it’s a creature card, put it onto the battlefield. Otherwise, you may put that card on the bottom of your library.
